name: fractional-pll-0.25
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "healthy.va"
ahdl_include "dut.va"
VR(ref 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=100n width=49n rise=100p fall=100p delay=10n
Vreset(rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0.9 2e-07 0.9 2.01e-07 0 6e-05 0 6.0001e-05 0.9 6.03e-05 0.9 6.0301e-05 0 0.0001 0]
VN(n 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 3 3e-05 3 3.0001e-05 4 0.0001 4]
VF(frac 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 1.5e-05 0 1.5001e-05 0.25 4.5e-05 0.25 4.5001e-05 0 7.5e-05 0 7.5001e-05 0.5 0.0001 0.5]
XO(tune rst dco) healthy_dco
X(ref rst n frac dco fb tune lock) fractional_pll
tran tran stop=100u maxstep=2n errpreset=conservative
save ref rst n frac dco fb tune lock
